work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. Independent act VI has its synopsis at 11486–11490 and papal protocol at 11493–11494, after the preceding act dating at 11472–11477 and before the next act VII at 12127. Retains the complete revocation through sections 1–13, the historical note at 11522–11525 and corrections at 11908–11909 and 11963, and the original dating at 12116–12122 together with editorial dating at 12124. No foreign act text or apparatus is included. Substantive-extent re-audit: The present revocation is printed through the operative revocation at 11701–11724 and the remaining thirteen sections, rather than replaced by an editorial summary.
